```{r}
#| eval: false
fungaR::funga_version()
```

### Description

Retrieves and summarizes metadata of the currently available versions of the
combined plant and fungal taxonomic and distributional checklist published by the
[Flora e Funga do Brasil (FFB)](https://floradobrasil.jbrj.gov.br/consulta/),
hosted by the [Rio de Janeiro Botanical Garden](https://www.gov.br/jbrj/pt-br).
The metadata includes version number, publication date, number of records, and
direct access URLs.

### Details

This function accesses the [IPT metadata for the FFB dataset](https://ipt.jbrj.gov.br/jbrj/resource?r=lista_especies_flora_brasil)
and extracts version information for each published data release. It returns
a cleaned and structured summary as a data frame.

### Value

A `data.frame` with the following columns:

- `Version`: Version number of the dataset release.
- `Published_on`: Timestamp of the dataset release.
- `Records`: Number of records in the release (FFB publishes plants and fungi together in one archive; `funga_parse()` is what subsets this down to the Fungi kingdom).
- `URL`: Direct link to the dataset version on the IPT portal.

### Examples

```r
ffb_version <- funga_version()
  head(ffb_version)
```
